svg.text: Deployed implementation (single AZ, no NAT gateway, as the instructor asked)
Region ap-southeast-1 (Singapore); CloudFront serves MY, TH and HK from nearby edge locations.
VPC 10.20.0.0/16 (2 AZs; everything that runs is in AZ a)
nodes in AZ a + AZ b
public IP, inbound only from ALB
image + DB secrets via the tasks' public IPs
ECS services, 1 task each, in AZ a's public subnet
(public IP for egress only; inbound only from the ALB),
no NAT gateway, single-AZ RDS. HA is design only.
reporting: DB login reporting_ro, read-only, views only.
QuickSight removed: not available on the AWS Free plan.
Solid: request path. Dashed: async, egress
or optional. Dashed box: design only.
